This preserves a clear approach from both west-wall doors and leaves an access aisle along the bed’s west side. The table serves as a bedside table, with the book and bowl on top. The dresser and stand use the south wall area, while the shallow shelf occupies the north-west corner beyond the door approaches. The basket is centered between the two specified bags on the dresser. The remaining bag is directly south of the bed so the bed faces it. Small items are stored on furniture or kept along peripheral areas to preserve circulation.
[/Reason]
</reasoning>
